@graph.name: Miami-Dade Cooling Stations
@graph.description: A point feature class with all of the cooling centers in Miami-Dade County. These sites consist of libraries and certain parks and recreation locations. These sites can be activated in case of a heat emergency.

additionalProperty.name: process_step
additionalProperty.value:
#########
  # GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
  # and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
  ####
  
  #########
  # Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
  ####
  
  # create directory structure and move into it
  mkdir -p /data/mdc_cooling_stations/download -p /data/mdc_cooling_stations/etl
  chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_cooling_stations
  cd /data/mdc_cooling_stations
  
  # set update flag based on last update and update frequency
  do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1
  
  # download if update flag is set:
  if do_update == 1 then
  wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=1 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 10 -O download/mdc_cooling_stations.json 'https://services.arcgis.com/8Pc9XBTAsYuxx9Ny/arcgis/rest/services/Cooling_Centers/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&returnGeometry=true&outSR=4326&f=geojson' 2>&1
  
  # load into postGIS with:
  ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/mdc_cooling_stations.json -nlt point -nln mdc_cooling_stations
  echo success: mdc_cooling_stations.json loaded with ogr2ogr
  
  
  #########
  # Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
  ####
  
  # remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
  UPDATE mdc_cooling_stations
    SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));
  
  # add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
  ALTER TABLE mdc_cooling_stations DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
  SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
    'mdc_cooling_stations',
    'geom_local', 2236, 'point', 2
  );
  UPDATE mdc_cooling_stations
    SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(geom,2236)));
  CREATE INDEX mdc_cooling_stations_geom_local_idx
    ON mdc_cooling_stations
    USING GIST (geom_local);
  NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
